debug_mode.label: Debug mode
debug_mode.help: Log shutdown and reboot instead of doing them

wlan_power_save.label: WLAN power saving
wlan_power_save.help: Off keeps the box reachable; empty leaves the system setting

sound_card.label: Sound card (I²S)
sound_card.help: An I²S sound card on the header; takes effect after 'lauschctl setup raspi' and a reboot

onboard_audio.label: On-chip audio (headphone jack)
onboard_audio.help: Off with an external sound card (always off with an I²S sound card)

i2c.label: I²C
i2c.help: Also switched on for a battery sensor

spi.label: SPI
spi.help: Also switched on for an RC522 reader
